summary:
Validation of HEAD 9e13b09, attempt 3. Since the build that validate-1 ran real cases against (f513faf), only .taad/fitness.yaml, eng/rules-harness/plants.json and slice records have changed. Nothing under src/ or tests/ changed.

**Criteria 1–11 are met, measured on this machine's desktop at HEAD.**
- I republished the shipped exe (139,896,472 bytes, the same size as before).
- All twelve SL-065 window cases passed against it: C-001, B-007, B-008 and S-001 to S-009, each exit 0 and PASSED.
- stripRows is 1, including with a real 12,345-folder denied count at MinWidth 560.
- OutcomeTabs keeps 164.84 px across the tab switch.
- Maximized runs lay out at 1936x1048, and S-008 has 171 ok lines.
- Core tests pass 381/381, rules-parity reports AGREE, and the Fitness check says every rule holds.
- No app or test host was left running.

**O-017 is fixed.** I ran the engine's own `taad3.fitness` on scratch copies of MainWindow.xaml with the HEAD rule.
- Quiet, as they should be: the clean file, S13, a comment as DriveScroller's first child, a legitimate third TabItem whose caption ScrollViewer holds a comment above a ListView in a star row, and a self-closing ScrollViewer beside a list.
- Fire, as they should: S09–S12 (each at 107), '>' inside an attribute, a DataGrid after comment + Resources + comment, and a third TabItem with a ListView straight inside a ScrollViewer (364).
- The S09–S13 batch gives four hits and no stray.

**O-018 (owed to build-slice) is real at HEAD and not done.** The HEAD rule:
- fires at 190 on a XAML example written inside the contract comment;
- fires at 363 on a commented-out ScrollViewer + ListView block;
- gives two hits (107 and 366) beside one real violation;
- misses `</ScrollViewer.Style >` with a space, and a self-closing `<ScrollViewer.Resources />` before a list.

I ran O-018's proposed pattern, unapplied, on all 18 variants, and it came out 18/18 as expected.

**Criterion 12 is met for its own shape**, a third TabItem, but the rule that enforces it still carries O-018. Criteria 13 (keyboard) and 14 (DPI), both material:false, were not checked.

**This is a loop.** Build attempts 2 and 3 were both caused by code-review findings, both changed config only, and both touched the same regex at fitness.yaml:810. O-018 would make attempt 4 the same kind of change on the same line. Each lap fixed exactly what it was asked, and the next review found another edge. That will keep happening, for two reasons:
- a regex over XML has an open-ended tail of edge cases;
- eng/rules-harness/harness.py still exits 2 (CANNOT MEASURE: the unran import rule), so no plant row runs unattended.

My recommendation: apply O-018 verbatim, with quiet plant rows for the two in-comment shapes and fire rows for the two missed forms. After that, record further regex edges as accepted under the design's 'deliberately narrow' scope unless they hit a shape the house style writes. Fixing the harness baseline is the lasting remedy.

I deleted the scratch folders I made, including the one the harness kept. The working tree is unchanged.

obligations.evidence: Owed to build-slice and not done at HEAD 9e13b09: line 810 still holds the O-017 pattern. My engine run (taad3.fitness content_hits, SL-065 rule only, scratch copies) reproduces every part of it. A commented-out ScrollViewer+ListView block fires at 363. A XAML example inside the contract comment fires at 190. A real violation beside a commented block gives two hits, [107, 366]. '</ScrollViewer.Style >' and a self-closing '<ScrollViewer.Resources />' before a list are both missed. O-018's proposed pattern on the same 18 variants was 18/18 as expected, with no regression on S09-S13, the O-017 shapes or the third-tab shapes. When it is applied, build-slice should add quiet plant rows for the two in-comment shapes and fire rows for the two missed forms, so the next revision is pinned on both sides.
